title_i18n.zh: 与运行时无关的 AI 工作流：一种兼顾生产环境稳定性和快速评估迭代的模式
title_i18n.en: Runtime-agnostic AI workflows: a model that balances production stability with rapid evaluation iteration.
title_i18n.es: Flujo de trabajo de IA independiente del tiempo de ejecución: un patrón que equilibra la estabilidad en producción con la iteración rápida de evaluación.

excerpt_i18n.zh: AI 工作流是一系列为完成某项任务而串联起来的步骤，其中一个或多个步骤包含对 大语言模型（LLM） 的调用。在此，我们将这些步骤组合在一起的逻辑（包括步骤的顺序和分支）称为工作流的协调逻辑。
excerpt_i18n.en: An AI workflow is a series of interconnected steps designed to complete a task, where one or more steps involve calls to a large language model (LLM). Here, we refer to the logic that combines these steps—including their order and branching—as the workflow's coordination logic.
excerpt_i18n.es: Un flujo de trabajo de IA es una serie de pasos encadenados para completar una tarea, en la que uno o más pasos incluyen llamadas a un modelo de lenguaje grande (LLM). Aquí, la lógica que agrupa estos pasos (incluido el orden y las ramificaciones de los pasos) se denomina lógica de orquestación del flujo de trabajo.

The round was led by China Mobile's Chain Leader Fund, with existing shareholders Fosun Chuangfu and Shenzhen Capital Group making additional investments, totaling over one hundred million yuan. BridgeDP Robotics stated that the funds will primarily be used in four areas: ecosystem development for the RoboCraft AI general-purpose robot motion capability development platform, capacity expansion of the cross-embodiment full-body motion data factory, continuous iteration of motion control models, and expansion and compliance of overseas technical service systems. Going forward, BridgeDP Robotics will continue to build on motion control as its foundation, extending vertically into key areas such as manipulation and world models, to accelerate the creation of a global general-purpose robot operating system. China Mobile's Chain Leader Fund commented: "As the embodied intelligence industry accelerates from technical validation to large-scale application, industry competition is shifting from competition in individual technical capabilities to comprehensive competition in underlying infrastructure, platform capabilities, and industrial ecosystems. BridgeDP Robotics not only possesses industry-leading motion control R&D capabilities but, more importantly, has distilled key technical experience such as cross-embodiment motion development and Sim2Real into reusable platform capabilities, continuously evolving toward a general-purpose robot operating system. We are optimistic about BridgeDP Robotics' long-term development potential in embodied intelligence foundational software and motion intelligence, and look forward to its efforts in advancing robots from 'being able to move' to 'moving intelligently.'"
